program.section_heading: Automotive T-TEN Performance and Driveability Specialist Certificate
outcomes: demonstrate the requisite knowledge and skills to diagnose body electrical faults on Toyota and Lexus vehicles.
demonstrate the requisite knowledge and skills to transfer their knowledge of Toyota and Lexus body electrical diagnosis to other vehicle manufacturers they may encounter at the dealer.
The student will demonstrate knowledge and skills related to providing quality vehicle service to the Toyota and Lexus customers.
careers: Toyota/Lexus automotive performance and drivability specialist

notes: Outcomes were taken from the page's outcomes tab; the 'OUTCOME N:' labels were dropped as list numbers.

The printed outcomes refer to body electrical diagnosis, which seems to fit another T-TEN certificate better than Performance and Driveability; a reviewer should check whether the outcomes tab belongs to this program.
Careers come from the program description: 'employment as a Toyota/Lexus automotive performance and drivability specialist' and 'competencies required of performance and drivability technicians'.
The certificate requires 100% of course work at Cypress College, with a minimum grade of C, and courses must be taken in the listed sequence.
